## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, desired outcome, and delivered change. Link the canonical backlog item and affected FR/BR/INV/SC/MC IDs.

## Scope and compatibility

Explain code/specification/configuration changes, exclusions, public contract compatibility, and operational implications. State which functionality remains planned.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant local build, format, lint, tests, documentation, and naming checks passed.
- [ ] Workflow changes passed pinned actionlint validation.
- [ ] All required hosted workflows passed for the exact candidate commit; links/SHA are included below.
- [ ] Rules, acceptance examples, ADRs, runbooks, and backlog status match the implementation.
- [ ] Generated files/logs, secrets, and unrelated changes are excluded.

Record actual commands, results, hosted run links, and revision. Do not check a box for a future or skipped test. Explain genuinely inapplicable checks.

## Risks and rollback

Describe material failure modes, data/configuration migration, and a safe revert/recovery path. For financial or recovery changes, include invariant/crash evidence rather than only a happy-path demo.
